input._script:
result = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    manifestPath = "/scratch/coop/drozda/unstructured-mesh-writer/Manifest.toml"
    txt = lowercase(read(manifestPath, String))
    lines = split(read(manifestPath, String), "\n")
    out = String[]
    for (idx, ln) in enumerate(lines)
        if occursin("gmsh", lowercase(ln))
            startIdx = max(1, idx - 1)
            for k = startIdx:min(length(lines), idx + 3)
                push!(out, lines[k])
            end
            push!(out, "---")
        end
    end
    result["status"] = "ok"
    result["n_lines"] = length(lines)
    result["snippet"] = join(out, " | ")
catch e
    result["status"] = "error"
    result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end
esc(s) = replace(string(s), "\"" => "\\\"")
println("""{"status":"$(esc(get(result,"status","?")))","n_lines":$(get(result,"n_lines","null")),"snippet":"$(esc(get(result,"snippet","")))","error":"$(esc(get(result,"error","")))"}""")
